svg.text: The bar is the request rate. The label behind it is how many times slower that server is than the fastest server in this chart, which is
the dashed line. The range on each bar is the spread of the round-paired comparison: both servers were measured in the same round, so the
range is the spread of the comparison rather than the drift of the host. 12 cores, 7910 MB · Linux 6.8.0-139-generic · PHP 8.5.11 (cli) ·
volucer c3da7ff · 8 arms · c=8,16,32,64, 5s per cell, 3 repeats
